summary: Bidirectional alignment fails: several P2P/UI assertions grade undocumented private contracts, while material CLI, seed preservation, quota-on-deliver, backoff, disabled-claim, lease-expiry, Content-Type, and required audit actions remain untested or only partially covered.

evidence.observation: Work request binds delivery-contract.md; requires env wiring, schema boot, seed/catalog preservation, claim/delivery/quota/signature/replay/audit/UI alignment, rebuild of outboxd/outboxctl, and fresh-DB API/CLI/UI contract satisfaction without reshaping the public tree.

Binding protocol covers env vars, routes/schemas, claim fencing, pause/disable, HMAC headers/canonical bytes, backoff schedule, quota on enqueue and deliver/complete, required audit actions, CLI subcommands, and UI field/error-box rules.
Optional operator notes (seed tenants, OUTBOX_SYNC tip); not referenced by instruction and not used as a second prompt.
F2P covers health, tenant/endpoint create, enqueue, idempotency, disabled enqueue, list/get events, and stats shape including undocumented by_status key.

F2P covers claim lease, lease_held, renew, pause reject, lease_mismatch, HMAC signature headers, DLQ after max_attempts, and attempts list; does not assert backoff seconds, Content-Type, or lease-expiry reclaim.
Quota tested for failed-attempt ignore and enqueue 429 after success; no deliver/complete 429 path. Audit covers enqueue/claim/dlq/pause/deliver.ok only.
Replay auth (missing bearer), successful replay+audit, resume claim, UI index title/error-box, JS field-name/error surfacing checks, and schema.sql presence.
P2P asserts health, undocumented not_found 404 string, undocumented non-object payload 400, tenant list, and undocumented enqueue audit detail.endpoint_id.
Live outboxd fixture always sets OUTBOX_* env vars, OUTBOX_SYNC=1, and temp DB; never exercises seeded catalog DB or outboxctl CLI binary.
Builds outboxd and outboxctl then runs pytest modules; no CLI invocation assertions.
UI interface used to interpret UI tests; claim posts owner/seconds today (solver-visible drift vs contract lease_owner/lease_seconds).
Instruction/docs boundary, completeness, reverse-outline, and hidden-test leakage rules applied to instruction.md and delivery-contract.md.

findings.why_it_matters: test_p2p_get_missing_event_404 grades HTTP 404 plus error=not_found, but the solver-visible contract never defines missing-resource status or error token.
findings.minimal_remediation: Document GET missing-event 404/{"error":"not_found"} in delivery-contract.md (or instruction), or drop/soften the P2P assertion to discoverable behavior only.
findings.regression_risk: Solvers can change error vocabulary while repairing APIs and fail despite contract-compliant routes.

findings.why_it_matters: test_p2p_invalid_payload_rejected requires rejecting array payloads with 400, but payload-type validation/status is not stated in the binding contract.
findings.minimal_remediation: Add payload-must-be-object + 400 semantics to the contract, or remove the P2P case.
findings.regression_risk: Pass/fail depends on an undocumented validation preference.

findings.why_it_matters: test_p2p_enqueue_audit_detail_has_endpoint requires detail.endpoint_id; the contract only shows detail as an object and does not require that field.
findings.minimal_remediation: Specify required audit detail keys for enqueue, or delete the field-specific P2P assertion.
findings.regression_risk: Hidden audit-detail schema becomes a private grading contract.

findings.why_it_matters: test_f2p_stats_endpoint_shape requires a by_status key; the contract only says stats returns counts by status plus tenants/endpoints, without naming by_status.
findings.minimal_remediation: Publish the exact stats JSON schema including by_status, or assert only discoverable fields/semantics.
findings.regression_risk: Alternate compliant stats shapes fail the verifier.

findings.why_it_matters: test_f2p_ui_index_served requires the literal title Outbox Delivery Plane; UI contract only requires serving /app/outbox/ui at / and an error-box element.
findings.minimal_remediation: Assert status 200 + error-box (and optional contract field names) without branding copy, or document the required page title.
findings.regression_risk: Cosmetic HTML copy changes fail an otherwise contract-compliant UI.

findings.why_it_matters: Instruction and contract require outboxctl CLI flows; test.sh builds the binary but no test invokes health/tenants/enqueue/claim/deliver/replay/pause/resume/audit via outboxctl.
findings.minimal_remediation: Add behavioral CLI tests against the contract subcommands, or narrow instruction/contract so CLI is not a graded deliverable.
findings.regression_risk: Broken CLI can score 1 while the stated work request fails.

findings.why_it_matters: Instruction requires keeping the seeded catalog/events intact for operators, but the verifier always boots a fresh temp DB and never checks seed preservation.
findings.minimal_remediation: Add a P2P/boot check against the seeded DB/catalog, or remove the seed-preservation ask from instruction.
findings.regression_risk: Agents can wipe or ignore seed data and still pass.

findings.why_it_matters: Contract requires deliver/complete-as-delivered to return 429 quota_exceeded and not mark delivered when the rolling window is full; tests only cover enqueue 429 after a prior success.
findings.minimal_remediation: Add a case that fills quota then attempts deliver/complete delivered and asserts 429 + non-delivered state.
findings.regression_risk: Enqueue-only quota fixes pass while delivery-path quota is wrong.

findings.why_it_matters: Backoff schedule [5,15,45,120,300] and intermediate failure staying pending with updated next_attempt_at/cleared lease are stated in the contract; tests only assert final dlq after max_attempts.
findings.minimal_remediation: Assert first-failure pending + next_attempt_at delta matching backoff(n), then dlq at max_attempts.
findings.regression_risk: Incorrect retry timing still passes DLQ-only checks.

findings.why_it_matters: Required audit actions include deliver.fail and resume; verifier never asserts either, while resume behavior is only checked via subsequent claim success.
findings.minimal_remediation: Assert deliver.fail on failed delivery and resume audit after resume endpoint calls.
findings.regression_risk: Missing required audit actions remain invisible to grading.

findings.why_it_matters: Contract says enabled=false rejects claim with endpoint_unavailable; tests cover disabled enqueue and paused claim, but not disabled claim.
findings.regression_risk: Pause-only claim fencing can pass while disabled claim is wrong.

findings.why_it_matters: Claim fencing allows reclaim when lease_until expired; no test expires a lease and successfully claims with another owner.
findings.minimal_remediation: Add short-lease expiry then second-owner claim success.
findings.regression_risk: Permanent lease lockbugs can still pass concurrent-holder tests.

findings.why_it_matters: Delivery HTTP requires Content-Type application/json; signature tests check X-Outbox-* headers and body HMAC but never Content-Type.
findings.minimal_remediation: Assert captured Content-Type is application/json on deliver.
findings.regression_risk: Header contract can be violated without failing the suite.

findings.why_it_matters: Contract requires compact JSON of payload without defining key ordering/whitespace rules; signature verification uses the captured body, so competing compact encodings can be ambiguously accepted or rejected relative to intent.
findings.minimal_remediation: Define compact encoding rules (e.g., sorted keys, no insignificant whitespace) in the contract and/or assert body bytes against that encoder.
findings.regression_risk: Signature/body grading depends on an underspecified serialization.

findings.why_it_matters: Instruction requires bringing worker paths back in line, but the verifier only exercises OUTBOX_SYNC=1 claim/deliver helpers; whether the async worker loop is graded remains unclear.
findings.minimal_remediation: Either test worker-driven delivery without relying solely on SYNC helpers, or clarify instruction that SYNC deliver path is the graded worker contract.
findings.regression_risk: Solvers may skip real worker repair and still pass, or waste effort on ungraded paths.

findings.why_it_matters: Contract says invalid bearer tokens also yield 401 unauthorized; only missing Authorization is tested.
findings.minimal_remediation: Add replay with Authorization: Bearer wrong-token → 401.
findings.regression_risk: Token comparison bugs may go uncaught if only empty-header path works.

findings.why_it_matters: without reshaping the public tree is preservation intent without a stated tree boundary or verifier check.
findings.minimal_remediation: Name preserved top-level paths or add a light P2P layout check; keep advisory unless made graded.
findings.regression_risk: Unclear preservation scope for solvers; currently non-blocking because ungraded.

change_scope: Align P2P/UI assertions with documented contracts or extend delivery-contract.md for graded private fields/errors/title/stats shape.
Add verifier coverage for CLI, seed preservation, quota-on-deliver/complete, backoff/next_attempt_at, disabled claim, lease expiry reclaim, Content-Type, deliver.fail/resume audits.
Clarify compact JSON encoding and whether async worker loops are in graded scope.
do_not_change: Do not weaken legitimate F2P claim/HMAC/idempotency/pause/replay/UI field-name/error-box contracts that already map to delivery-contract.md.
Do not convert delivery-contract.md into a hidden-test checklist or add implementation-diagnosis bullets to instruction.md.
Do not expose test module names or oracle repair maps in solver-visible docs.
next_gate: Q2 Verifier Coverage Repairer and/or Q1 Spec Gap Repairer for phantoms; Q3 for compact-JSON/worker-scope ambiguities; then re-run Q4.

REQUIREMENT_TEST_MATRIX.REQUIREMENT: Restore /app/outbox API/worker/CLI/UI behavior to delivery-contract without reshaping the public tree.
Wire startup via OUTBOX_DB/ADDR/DATA/TOKEN/SYNC (and contract OUTBOX_ROOT); create parent dirs; listen on OUTBOX_ADDR.
Apply /app/outbox/db/schema.sql on boot; serve UI from /app/outbox/ui at /; rebuild outboxd/outboxctl.
Tenant/endpoint CRUD-ish routes and identifier prefixes.
Enqueue pending events; idempotent enqueue returns existing with 200.
Disabled endpoints reject enqueue with 409 endpoint_disabled; paused endpoints still allow enqueue; disabled/paused reject claim with endpoint_unavailable.
Claim fencing: claimed+lease_owner/lease_until; second owner 409 lease_held; same-owner renew; lease_mismatch on complete/deliver; expired lease reclaimable.
Deliver POSTs compact JSON with Content-Type and X-Outbox-Id/Timestamp/Signature HMAC canonical bytes; 2xx→delivered else failed.
Backoff schedule and intermediate pending+next_attempt_at; dlq when attempt_count>=max_attempts.
Quota counts successful deliveries in 3600s; failed ignored; enqueue and deliver/complete-delivered return 429 quota_exceeded.
Replay from dlq with bearer when OUTBOX_TOKEN set; missing/invalid→401 unauthorized; success→pending + replay audit.
Required audit actions: enqueue, claim, deliver.ok, deliver.fail, dlq, replay, pause, resume.
CLI outboxctl subcommands talk to OUTBOX_ADDR per contract.
UI forms use lease_owner/lease_seconds/idempotency_key/payload; show API errors in #error-box textContent.
Fresh DB boot of repaired binaries satisfies API/CLI/UI contract flows.
TESTS: outbox fixture fresh DB + API/UI F2P suite

PHANTOM_TEST_CONTRACTS: test_f2p_ui_index_served → literal title Outbox Delivery Plane undocumented

Whether async worker loop is graded versus OUTBOX_SYNC deliver helpers (Q4-015)
Stats counts-by-status response shape / by_status naming (ties to Q4-004)
